title: Invoice Minimum Schedule for Authorization Corrections — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Schedule — Insurance Coverage & Claims, authorization corrections (CO-197).** The billing-error corrections adjusted on the order's patient invoice come off an authorization correction once their total reaches the authorization correction's invoice minimum, set by the amount the claim billed at filing.

| Amount billed at filing | Invoice minimum |
|---|---|
| Below 250.00 USD (small claim amount) | 1.00 USD (small-claim invoice minimum) |
| From 250.00 USD up to but not including 1000.00 USD (mid claim amount) | 5.00 USD (mid-claim invoice minimum) |
| 1000.00 USD and above | 10.00 USD (standard invoice minimum) |

### Notes

1. A claim billed exactly 250.00 USD falls in the middle band; one billed 249.99 USD in the first.
2. A claim billed exactly 1000.00 USD falls in the last band; one billed 999.99 USD in the middle band.
3. Corrections totalling exactly the minimum reach it.

### Hypothetical application

A claim billed 1450.00 USD, with billing-error corrections of 7.00 USD on the order's invoice: the minimum is 10.00 USD and is not reached. Billed 600.00 USD with the same corrections: the minimum is 5.00 USD and is reached.
